text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, look, look! The sunset is so 
totally orange!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh... I wanna write! Turbo really, 
really wants to write right now!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Uuu! Trainer, let's go! Somewhere we can 
see better! Hurry, hurry!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the sunset, Twin Turbo suddenly 
made a big fuss. And where she led me was—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! A sunset! We can see it so well! 
Look, look! It's bright orange!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, hmm, I get it now! Trainer, gimme 
some paper!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Did she want to draw something? I hand 
Twin Turbo some paper and look up at the 
sky. It's certainly a beautiful sunset, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Done! Here, this is for you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The paper I received had the word "Dusk" 
written on it. I know Twin Turbo has nice 
handwriting... but today, it felt 
different somehow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's not like she didn't know the kanji... 
Besides, the handwriting looks softer than 
usual...?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I mean, look!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo points at the sky. Spreading 
her arms wide just like that—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Amazing, isn't it! Come on, 
Trainer, you write something too!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking my agreement, she pouts and begs 
me to write something as well.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, if it isn't Turbo and Turbo's 
Trainer. What a coincidence~. Are you two 
heading back from a walk as well—"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Machitan! Machitan, do you wanna write 
too!? Trainer, paper, paper!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mm? What is it, what is it? What game are 
you playing?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After giving a brief explanation, Matikane 
Tannhauser nods in understanding and sets 
her pen to paper.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hmm, like this, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon receiving the paper, the words 
"Evening Glow" were written there. Next to 
them was a drawing of a cute little spider 
dangling from a thread.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Mmh, not bad, Machitan! So cute! The 
spider is dangling!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Nfufu. Oh gosh, I'm blushing. Did you see 
how cute spiders are? Sway, sway, swaying 
along♪

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Alright, next! It's your turn, Trainer! 
Hurry, hurry!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hurried along by Twin Turbo, I faced the 
paper. Using hiragana, drawing pictures... 
I wasn't really sure what the right answer 
was, but—
choice_data_list: Write while imitating the two of them
Write it like you normally would.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following their lead, I wrote "Sunset" in 
hiragana and drew a small bird right next 
to it.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Is this your handwriting, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The bird is so cute! It's kind of like... 
*pew-pew*, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, Turbo wanted to see Trainer's 
sunset!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Can't be helped! It's your first time, so 
next time for sure!! Next time, make sure 
it's the Trainer edition!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, without being able to give her 
the correct answer, I just watched Twin 
Turbo happily exclaim, "What should I 
write next!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Her usual handwriting! So easy to read! 
Wait, this isn't Trainer's sunset!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I mean, look! The sunset! Isn't it 
incredible?! Right!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That color really whets the appetite, 
doesn't it~? Ah, just looking at it makes 
me want to eat a baked sweet potato... 
*drool*.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
! Turbo wants some too!! Trainer, let's go 
buy it! Machitan, let's gooo!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to ask what they meant, but their 
minds and bodies were already fixated on 
the roasted sweet potatoes... In the end, 
I never got the chance to ask.
